description: MTA Staten Island Railway On-Time Performance: Beginning 2006 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. On-Time Performance (OTP) measures the percentage of trains arriving at their destination terminals as scheduled. While the main measure for OTP excludes delays caused by trains held for connections with the Staten Island Ferry, OTP including boat delays is also included. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are reliability, scheduled service, service, sir, on-time performance. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
